Author: Infi, Anna
Name: Chat 2 Vanilla
Description:
A Chat 2 fork that looks like the game's own chat window, with unlimited tabs.
Turn off Vanilla style for the normal Chat 2 look. Installs alongside Chat 2.

Based on Chat 2 by Anna and Infi (EUPL-1.2): https://github.com/Infiziert90/ChatTwo
Punchline: Chat 2 that looks like the vanilla chat window.
Changelog:
**1.43.11**
- Import your tabs from the game's chat settings
- Optional input box tint by chat channel
- Per-tab log background color and log transparency setting
- Toggle for the gold highlight on tabs with new messages
- Vanilla Style settings now have their own tab, with shorter descriptions
- Fixed pop-out resizing, saving, and text spilling past the log
- More reliable game font on all machines

**1.42.0**
- First release
